method: Uniform steady 1D rod with fixed hot and cold ends, constant properties and distributed mean Joule heating: Q_hot=G*(Th-Tc)-I_rms^2*R/2; Q_cold=G*(Th-Tc)+I_rms^2*R/2. Positive Q_hot leaves the molten head.
limits: Screening thermal/electrical properties, not a sourced temperature fit.
Fixed endpoint temperatures require actual heater and cooling; no transient, radiation, gas cooling or contact resistance.
A longer thermal path increases lead voltage loss. The driver budget must include the assembled resistance and inductance.
